widgets_values: Glossy biomorphic / bacterial slime sculpture — dense vein-like filament networks mixed with translucent gelatinous folds and blobs, in a specialized color palette of pale peach, soft salmon pink, coral red, and golden yellow on a pure black background. It feels like moss, fungus, biofilm, or microscopic organic growth, with wet reflective surfaces, translucent fleshy undertones, and intricate cellular detail. Perform high-fidelity video style transfer on Video1 using the physical textures, impasto depth, wet highlights, and delicate palette of pale peach, soft salmon pink, coral red, and golden yellow from Image1, Image2, Image3, and Image4. Strictly preserve the exact physical motion paths, trajectories, curves, velocity, and timing of the moving brushstrokes from Video1 without altering their structure or animation layout.
